SERVE AT CROsspoint

Partner with us as we minister to Christ's Kingdom through serving. God's Word encourages us to serve one another through allocating our gifts and resources for the church body. You can read about different areas to serve here: 

Connect Team
Practice hospitality by creating a welcoming environment, while engaging with guests and those seeking to connect deeper to the Crosspoint community. Sign up here.

For CP'S CSER opportunities please check the LU CSER Portal.
Coffee
Bless others and create community by serving coffee at no expense to our guests and members. Sign up here.

For CP'S CSER opportunities please check the LU CSER Portal.
Praise Band
Use musical abilities to glorify Christ and prepare the church’s heart to receive the Word. Sign up here.

For CP'S CSER opportunities please check the LU CSER Portal.
Prayer Team
Pray directly over people at the end of each service and receive prayer request to pray for current needs. Sign up here.
CP Kids
Disciple children, empower families and equip volunteers through any of awesome teams: Host Team, Nursery Team, PreK Team, K-3rd Grade Team, 4th-5th Grade (Pre-Teen) Team or Packing Party Team.  Apply HERE today!


Serving Eligibility Requirements:
- Be at least 18 years of age to serve as an adult.

- A student 12-13 years old can serve alongside an approved parent/guardian.

- A student 14-17 years old can serve alongside any approved volunteer the age of 18 or older.

- Attend CP Church regularly for a minimum of four (4) months prior to serving. (CP staff reserves the right to make decisions regarding internships and practicum students.)

- Be approved by ministry leadership following completion of all screening requirements.

For CP'S CSER opportunities please check the LU CSER Portal.
CP Youth
Invest in the next generation through working with our youth group as a small group leader. CP Youth provides a place for students to learn about Christ, grow in their faith, and find community with each other. Apply to serve HERE.

Eligibility Requirements:
- Be at least eighteen (18) years of age to serve.
- Volunteers must be 18+ years old and no longer enrolled as a high school student.
- Attend CP Church regularly for a minimum of four (4) months prior to serving. (CP staff reserves the right to make decisions regarding internships and practicum students.)
- Be approved by ministry leadership following completion of all screening requirements

Outreach serving opportunities

Downtown Lunch Distribution
Our Downtown Lunch ministry team faithfully provides weekly lunches and prayer to those in need. Sign up here.
Crosspoint Care
Crosspoint Care specializes in serving our church community with tangible and financial needs. Sign up here.
Foster and Adoption Ministry
Tangibly Minister who foster and adoption families. Sign up here.
Special Events
Crosspoint hosts various in church special events that allow for serving opportunities outside of the Sunday service times.  Examples are worship night, Christmas Toy Shop, prayer and fasting events to name a few. Any of the ministry teams may be needed during special events. Sign up here.
